evidence: A-B is low-rank and centred on numbers (digit-reading q L10-12, k L11/12/17, v L15/16; digit-writing down_proj L15-17). First-order sycophancy signature: token-level OV copying of numbers rose in A (sum Δz +30 over 72 heads, null sd ~8.5; colours/capitals/controls null), concentrated in layer-15 attention (digits +9.7, number words +13.8, mostly via o_proj), plus L14h2/L11. Conversely B's late MLPs (L14-17) and L16h2 gained number-writing capacity (z -3.7 to -9.7 vs random-word nulls), as expected for the model that must compute answers absent from the prompt. Caveats: digit-query stand-ins in layer 11 and B's capacity gains in copier heads point the other way; residual stand-ins in late layers are unreliable.
